answer_1.quote: Numerous works have explored methods for selecting the best quality training datasets and hyper-parameters based on smaller proxy models, evaluating them multiple times throughout training.
answer_1.outputs: The paper evaluates model outputs in NLG format by generating free-text answers to questions, using exact or proximity matching (e.g., BLEU) with gold answers.

answer_2.quote: For the generative formulation, exact (token-by-token) or proximity (e.g. BLEU) matching with the gold answer are used.
